current_candidate.summary: Spaces v27 addresses the screenshot-proven Map 5 depth failure. The camera is now almost on the bridge deck (roadY=-0.38), the bridge has a deep vertical body to Y=-5.6, and columns/signs are rendered before the bridge. The bridge top/body therefore overpaint and occlude the lower projected portions of the columns, so the shafts read as rising from below the suspended path instead of painting in front of it. The real 0.65 abyss gap remains.

open_feedback: Review the exact screenshot failure: the bridge should now cover the low parts of nearby columns rather than appearing to run underneath them.
Review the low camera: it should feel close to the deck and make the bridge dominate the foreground.
Review bridge thickness: side faces should sell a suspended mass without becoming walls.
Preserve black lower column sections, tall upper shafts, hidden signs and max two visible signs.
